description: List the workspace's brand kits: tone of voice, audience, keywords, and reference style images. Use one to keep drafted copy on-brand, and pass its id to generate_image for on-brand visuals.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.
